headline: TOR @ ATL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TOR 3.08 at ATL 4.81, with a projected total of 7.89. Batter research is strongest for Ernie Clement, Nathan Lukes, Michael Harris II, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Austin Riley, Myles Straw because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
